answer: One public jetty serves the whole registry: every identity must dock there and pay a spiral toll priced off its funder's mirror wallet, whose history is mirrored on-chain, so the registry counts each identity that lineage ever funded. The k-th identity from one lineage pays k times the $50 toll, locked and slashed on proven fraud; the registry never mints below the spiral price. Fresh wallets cannot dodge it: six epochs of seasoning, funds locked, before funding anything. Forging 1,000 puppets costs $50 x (1+2+...+1000) = $25,025,000; an honest user pays one $50 toll, once.
